Reach

Millions of views with nowhere to land

Your pinned reels have 15.4m, 721k and 654k views, and recent ones still reach 42.2k and 23.8k. When a reel takes off, there is no class to invite those viewers into, so most of that attention is gone the next day.

Time

Every offer is an hour of you

Sessions, intensives and coaching are all priced per session or per month of calls. Your income can only grow as far as your calendar, and one class can teach hundreds of people in the same hour.

Your list

The sign-up form wasn’t working

When I checked on 3 November, the Grow Together newsletter form on your site showed a setup error instead of a sign-up box. Every visitor who wanted your free content couldn’t join.

People already watch you by the million. There’s no moment yet that lets the right ones raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free masterclass on self-worth and relationships, with your workbook on the thank-you page

You already have a low-ticket product, so the class itself should be free. The Self Esteem Workbook sits on the thank-you page, and the replay page invites the people who are ready to apply for 1:1 self-worth and relationships coaching. It’s framed as education and coaching, not therapy.

Catches the viral moments

Every reel and every ad points to one free class. Viewers who would have scrolled on become sign-ups, and every sign-up is an email you keep.

One hour, hundreds of people

The class teaches the same thing you’d explain in a first session, to everyone at once, live or on replay. Your 1:1 time goes to the people who apply.

Rebuilds your list and the middle

Sign-ups replace the broken newsletter form, the workbook gives people a first purchase, and the class becomes the step between $5 and 1:1.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for 1:1 yet

They join the free class and many add the Self Esteem Workbook to keep going. The relationship starts with a purchase, and your emails keep them close until they’re ready.

The qualified 5%

Ready to invest in themselves now

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before a call, and the pre-call emails help them arrive clear on what they want.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Who it’s for

For anyone who wants to feel more at home in themselves

  • You want to understand where your beliefs about yourself came from.
  • You’d like to show up in your relationships as the person you really are.
  • You’re curious about practical tools you can use outside a session, on an ordinary Tuesday.
  • You want small, doable steps, not quick fixes or surface-level affirmations.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five pieces we’ll put together in one hour

Where your sense of worth was shaped

How the beliefs we hold about ourselves are learned, and why they can feel so true long after we’ve outgrown them.

“Too much” and “not enough”

Why these two stories are often the same story, and what it looks like to simply be human instead.

Self-worth in your relationships

How the way you see yourself shapes how you communicate, connect and repair with the people closest to you.

The 1% rule

The idea behind my 30 Day Push Challenge: small daily shifts for your body, mind and relationships, instead of drastic changes.

Tools you can use the same day

Simple, hands-on exercises to take into your week, so the class becomes something you practise, not just something you watched.

Meet Bailee

Hi, I’m Bailee Elkin

I’m a licensed marriage and family therapist, a coach and a mindfulness teacher in South Florida, where I’ve lived my whole life. I own The Jigsaw Collection and co-own Systemic Solutions Counseling, and I’m a Florida Qualified Supervisor.

The name Jigsaw comes from my parents’ hair salon, a staple in our community for decades. My work is about self-worth and relationships, and one belief sits underneath all of it: you’re not broken, you’re not “too much” or “not enough”, you’re human.

LMFTCoachFL Qualified SupervisorMindfulness teacher

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. The Missing Piece is an educational class about self-worth and relationships. It isn’t therapy and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Who is it for?

Anyone who wants to understand themselves and their relationships a little better, and leave with tools to practise.

What if I can’t make it live?

Sign up anyway. Everyone who registers gets the replay.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, listen, ask your questions, and decide afterwards if you’d like to go further with coaching.
